# silverpoint 0.8.0: the agent catalog

> silverpoint 0.8.0 draws 60 charts and 38 UI components as metal point on prepared paper, for React, Vue, Angular and Reflex (Python, through reflex-silverpoint-react), from one framework-free engine, on the silverpoint and cyanotype grounds with 6 palette presets; accessible and server-renderable.

Generated from https://silverpointweb.vercel.app/agent-catalog.json, the catalog `@silverpoint/mcp@0.8.0` ships (schema 1). Reflex: `reflex-silverpoint-react` 0.7.1, wrapping silverpoint 0.7.0. Its Reflex names are those of that release, which wraps silverpoint 0.7.0. React, Vue and Angular share each prop's name (Vue templates may write it in kebab-case); Reflex spells it in snake_case. The MCP server at https://silverpointweb.vercel.app/mcp answers from the same catalog.

## Stylesheets

- always: `@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css`, `@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css`
- ui: `@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css`
- timeline: `@knight-lab/timelinejs/dist/css/timeline.css`, `@silverpoint/grounds/timeline.css`

## Common props

### Every chart

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `data` | `readonly Datum[]` |  | Rows to draw. If omitted, the demo dataset is rendered (REQ-093): accessor props (`…Key`, `keys`, `names`, `levels`, `axis`, `dimensions`, `period`, `nodes`) are ignored, every other prop applies. |
| `ground` | `ground` | `GroundRef` | `'silverpoint'` | Style ground. Defaults to the app provider's, or `silverpoint`. |
| `substrate` | `substrate` | `SubstrateName` | `'cream'` | Prepared substrate within the ground (REQ-046). |
| `mode` | `mode` | `InkMode` | `'ink'` | `ink` by default; `precision` disables inking (REQ-021). |
| `palette` | `palette` | `Palette` |  | Colours over the ground's, field by field, written on the root's `style` (REQ-461). Merged over the dashboard's and the provider's (REQ-462); presets are on `@silverpoint/core/palettes`. |
| `seed` | `seed` | `Seed` |  | Seed. If omitted, it is derived from `id` stably (REQ-003). |
| `id` | `id` | `string` |  | Stable identifier. If omitted, it is generated deterministically. |
| `height` | `height` | `number` | `160` | Height of the drawing area in px. Width is the container's unless pinned. |
| `width` | `width` | `number` |  |  |
| `chrome` | `chrome` | `'card' \| 'bare'` | `'card'` | `card` draws the full frame; `bare` only the drawing area (REQ-095). |
| `hatchFill` | `hatch_fill` | `'tile' \| 'per-shape'` | `'tile'` | How areas are filled (REQ-029). |
| `title` | `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `badge` | `badge` | `string` |  |  |
| `value` | `value` | `string \| number` |  |  |
| `unit` | `unit` | `string` |  |  |
| `footerLeft` | `footer_left` | `string` |  |  |
| `footerRight` | `footer_right` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. If omitted, it is derived from `title` (REQ-120). |
| `description` | `description` | `string` |  | Long description for screen readers (REQ-120). |
| `dataTable` | `data_table` | `'visible' \| 'hidden' \| 'none'` | `'hidden'` | Tabular alternative; `hidden` leaves it for assistive technology only (REQ-121). |
| `locale` | `locale` | `string` |  |  |
| `numberFormat` | `number_format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` |  |  |
| `className` | `class_name` | `string` |  |  |

### Every UI component

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | — | `string` |  | The frame variant and every related id derive from it (REQ-307, REQ-329). |
| `seed` | `seed` | `Seed` |  | Overrides `id` for the frame variant only. |
| `ground` | `ground` | `GroundRef` | `'silverpoint'` | Style ground. Defaults to the dashboard's, then the app provider's, or `silverpoint` (REQ-311). |
| `substrate` | `substrate` | `SubstrateName` | `'cream'` | Prepared substrate within the ground (REQ-046). |
| `mode` | `mode` | `InkMode` | `'ink'` | `ink` by default; `precision` disables inking (REQ-021, REQ-306). |
| `palette` | `palette` | `Palette` |  | Colours over the ground's, merged over the dashboard's and the provider's (REQ-461, REQ-462). |
| `size` | `size` | `UiSize` | `'md'` | Default `'md'`. |
| `className` | — | `string` |  | Added to the component's root element, after its own classes. |

## Charts: Lines

### LineChart

`line-chart`: Spline with an optional dotted baseline series.

| Framework | Name | Import |
|---|---|---|
| React | `LineChart` | `@silverpoint/react/line-chart` |
| Vue | `SpLineChart` | `@silverpoint/vue/line-chart` |
| Angular | `sp-line-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/line-chart` |
| Reflex | `line_chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Data shape: `series`; fields: x → `xKey` (string), value → `valueKey` (number), secondary → `secondaryKey` (number, optional)
- Intents: trend, change, compare
- Demo dataset: `LINE_CHART_DEMO`
- Demo rows: `[{"hour": "00", "hits": 18, "baseline": 22}, {"hour": "02", "hits": 14, "baseline": 18}]`

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `x_key` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `value_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `secondaryKey` | `secondary_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `curve` | `curve` | `LineCurve` | `'monotone'` |  |
| `series` | `series` | `'all' \| 'primary'` | `'all'` | `all` draws the secondary series when there is one; `primary` omits it. |
| `connectNulls` | `connect_nulls` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether a gap left by a missing value is bridged (REQ-008). |

### SparklineRows

`sparkline-rows`: One row per series — name, sparkline, readout.

| Framework | Name | Import |
|---|---|---|
| React | `SparklineRows` | `@silverpoint/react/sparkline-rows` |
| Vue | `SpSparklineRows` | `@silverpoint/vue/sparkline-rows` |
| Angular | `sp-sparkline-rows` | `@silverpoint/angular/sparkline-rows` |
| Reflex | `sparkline_rows` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Data shape: `series`; fields: name → `nameKey` (string), points → `seriesKey` (array), point → `pointKey` (number, optional), readout → `readoutKey` (string, optional)
- Intents: trend, compare, kpi
- Demo dataset: `SPARKLINE_ROWS_DEMO`
- Demo rows: `[{"name": "API", "readout": "99.9%", "points": [98, 99, 99, 97, 99, 100, 99, 100]}, {"name": "Queue", "points": [12, 18, 15, 22, 19, 25, 21, 17]}]`

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | `rows` | `number` |  | Rows shown, from the first; all by default. |
| `nameKey` | `name_key` | `Accessor<string>` | `'name'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `readoutKey` | `readout_key` | `Accessor<string \| number \| null \| undefined>` | `'readout'` | The printed readout; the last value of the series by default. Ignored without `data`. |
| `seriesKey` | `series_key` | `Accessor<readonly unknown[] \| null \| undefined>` | `'points'` | The row's points: an array. Ignored without `data`. |
| `pointKey` | `point_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | The value of one point; the point itself when it is a number, else its `value`. Ignored without `data`. |

### KpiCard

`kpi-card`: A metric, its delta, and an area sparkline of the series.

| Framework | Name | Import |
|---|---|---|
| React | `KpiCard` | `@silverpoint/react/kpi-card` |
| Vue | `SpKpiCard` | `@silverpoint/vue/kpi-card` |
| Angular | `sp-kpi-card` | `@silverpoint/angular/kpi-card` |
| Reflex | `kpi_card` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Data shape: `single`; fields: value → `valueKey` (number)
- Intents: kpi, change
- Demo dataset: `KPI_CARD_DEMO`
- Demo rows: `[{"value": 118}, {"value": 124}]`

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `valueKey` | `value_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `metric` | `metric` | `string` |  | The metric's name, printed under the figure. |
| `delta` | `delta` | `number` |  | Signed change, printed with its sign and a direction mark. |
| `deltaTone` | `delta_tone` | `'up' \| 'down' \| 'flat'` | `delta` | Direction of the mark; from the sign of `delta` by default. |

### WaterfallChart

`waterfall-chart`: Totals from zero and floating deltas from the running total.

| Framework | Name | Import |
|---|---|---|
| React | `WaterfallChart` | `@silverpoint/react/waterfall-chart` |
| Vue | `SpWaterfallChart` | `@silverpoint/vue/waterfall-chart` |
| Angular | `sp-waterfall-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/waterfall-chart` |
| Reflex | `waterfall_chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Data shape: `categories`; fields: step → `stepKey` (string), base → `baseKey` (number, optional), delta → `deltaKey` (number, optional)
- Intents: change, part-to-whole
- Demo dataset: `WATERFALL_CHART_DEMO`
- Demo rows: `[{"step": "Opening", "base": 120}, {"step": "Sales", "delta": 64}]`

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stepKey` | `step_key` | `Accessor<string>` | `'step'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `baseKey` | `base_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'base'` | An absolute total: the bar starts at zero and resets the running total. Ignored without `data`. |
| `deltaKey` | `delta_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'delta'` | A change from the running total. Ignored without `data`. |

## Charts: Points & grids

### HeatmapChart

`heatmap-chart`: Labelled rows of values, normalised against `scaleMax`.

| Framework | Name | Import |
|---|---|---|
| React | `HeatmapChart` | `@silverpoint/react/heatmap-chart` |
| Vue | `SpHeatmapChart` | `@silverpoint/vue/heatmap-chart` |
| Angular | `sp-heatmap-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/heatmap-chart` |
| Reflex | `heatmap_chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Data shape: `matrix`; fields: label → `labelKey` (string), values → `valuesKey` (array)
- Intents: compare, distribution
- Demo dataset: `HEATMAP_CHART_DEMO`
- Demo rows: `[{"label": "Mon", "values": [12, 34, 58, 71, 66, 40]}, {"label": "Tue", "values": [18, 42, 77, 88, 70, 35]}]`

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `labelKey` | `label_key` | `Accessor<string>` | `'label'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valuesKey` | `values_key` | `Accessor<readonly (number \| null)[] \| null \| undefined>` | `'values'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `scaleMax` | `scale_max` | `number` | `100` | Value that maps to the darkest tone; 100 by default. |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `bins` | `bins` | `number \| readonly number[]` |  | A number asks for that many equal-width bins over the niced extent; an array gives the thresholds, increasing. Freedman–Diaconis by default, Sturges when the IQR is 0 (REQ-432). |
| `cumulative` | `cumulative` | `boolean` |  | Turns the counts into a running total. |
| `orientation` | `orientation` | `ChartOrientation` |  |  |

- Intents: distribution, compare
- Demo dataset: `VIOLIN_CHART_DEMO`

| Angular | `sp-polar-line-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/polar-line-chart` |
| Reflex | `polar_line_chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Data shape: `series`; fields: angle → `angleKey` (number), value → `valueKey` (number)
- Intents: trend, compare
- Demo dataset: `POLAR_LINE_CHART_DEMO`
- Demo rows: `[{"month": 0, "rain": 82}, {"month": 1, "rain": 62}]`

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angleKey` | `angle_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'angle'` | In the units of `period`. Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `value_key` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | The radius, `≥ 0`. Ignored without `data`. |
| `period` | `period` | `number` |  | One turn, in the units of the angle; when set, the line closes. Ignored without `data`. |
| `startAngle` | `start_angle` | `number` | `0` | Where the angle 0 sits, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock; 0 by default. |

| `type` | `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | Default `'button'`. |

| `block` | `block` | `boolean` |  | Fills the width of its container. |

### SpInput

`input` (ui, data-entry): A labelled text field with an optional message and an invalid state.

| Framework | Name | Import |
|---|---|---|
| React | `SpInput` | `@silverpoint/react/ui/input` |
| Vue | `SpInput` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/input` |
| Angular | `sp-input` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/input` |
| Reflex | `sp_input` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

- Binds `value`: React `value + onChange`; Vue `v-model`; Angular `[(value)]`
- Events: React `onChange`; Vue `change`; Angular none
- Slots: React `prefix`, `suffix`; Vue `prefix`, `suffix`; Angular `spPrefix`, `spSuffix`
- States: empty, filled, invalid, disabled

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `type` | `'text' \| 'search' \| 'email' \| 'url' \| 'tel' \| 'password' \| 'number'` | `'text'` | Native input type. Default `'text'`. |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | `string` |  | Hint shown while empty; not a substitute for the accessible name. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; the native input submits under it (REQ-323). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Not focusable and not submitted. |
| `readOnly` | `read_only` | `boolean` |  | Focusable and submitted, but not editable. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Sets `aria-invalid` and draws the exact ⚠ glyph (REQ-334). |
| `message` | `message` | `string` |  | Help or error text under the control, referenced by `aria-describedby` (REQ-334). |
| `label` | `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name, when no `<label for>` names the control. |

### SpBadge

| `side` | `side` | `'top' \| 'end' \| 'bottom' \| 'start'` | `'bottom'` | Default `'bottom'`. |
| `align` | `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'center'` | Default `'center'`. |
| `offset` | `offset` | `number` | `6` | Default `6`. |
| `closable` | `closable` | `boolean` | `false` | Default `false`. |
| `closeLabel` | `close_label` | `string` | `'Close'` | Default `'Close'`. |
| `width` | `width` | `string` | `'320px'` | CSS length. Default `'320px'` (from `ui.css`). |

### SpTooltip

`tooltip` (overlay, overlays): A short text shown on hover or focus of its trigger.

| Framework | Name | Import |

- Binds `open`: React `open + onOpenChange`; Vue `v-model:open`; Angular `[(open)]`

- States: open

- Events: React `onChange`, `onOpenChange`; Vue none; Angular none
- Slots: React none; Vue none; Angular none
- States: placeholder, open-selected

| Prop (React, Vue, Angular) | Reflex | Type | Default | Description |

| `width` | `width` | `string` | `'180px'` | CSS length. Default `'180px'` (from `ui.css`). |

## Grounds

| Ground | Substrates | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `silverpoint` | `cream`, `green`, `blue`, `ochre` | Metal point on prepared paper: hatched tone, a hand-inked line, cream and other prepared substrates. |
| `cyanotype` | `prussian` | A contact print: a white, exact line on Prussian blue; tone is line weight, nothing is hatched. |

| `heighten` |  | White heightening on the live value (always outlined with `ink`). |
| `rule` |  | Rules and baselines. |
| `grid` |  | Grid lines. |
| `text` |  | Large figures and primary labels. |
| `textMuted` |  | Axis labels and secondary text. |
| `focus` | `ink` | Focus ring of UI components; `ink` by default. |

## Diagnostics

| Code | Severity | Requirement | When | Remedy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SP001` | warn | REQ-007 | the dataset is empty; the ground's empty state is drawn | Pass at least one row, or omit `data` to see the demo dataset |
| `SP002` | warn | REQ-008 | a value cannot be drawn as given (null, not finite, or outside the data contract); it is corrected or omitted | Check the value against the chart's data contract (Data Model §2) |
| `SP003` | warn | REQ-009 | the container measures 0 px; the render is deferred | Give the container a size, or pin `width` and `height` |
| `SP004` | warn | REQ-010 | the scale domain has zero length; it is expanded with the ground's domainPadding | Nothing to do if the data is constant; otherwise check the accessor |
| `SP005` | error | REQ-025 | more than one element is marked with white heightening; only the first is applied | Heighten a single element per chart |
| `SP006` | warn | REQ-026 | the inker is not registered; falling back to NullInker | Register the inker or fix the ground's `inker` token |
| `SP007` | warn | REQ-045 | the ground is not registered; falling back to silverpoint | Call registerGround() before rendering, or fix the name |
| `SP008` | warn | REQ-096 | the data volume is above the family's threshold | Aggregate the data before charting it |
| `SP009` | error | REQ-097 | a scale bound cannot be derived from the data and was not supplied | Pass the named property explicitly |
| `SP010` | warn | REQ-091 | the chord ring has more than 12 categories | Group the smaller categories |
| `SP011` | warn | NFR §7 | the path byte budget of 40 KB is exceeded | Use `hatchFill: 'tile'` or a larger hatch gap |
| `SP012` | error | REQ-127 | the ground does not reach the minimum contrast | Recompute the palette; colours are not chosen by eye |
| `SP013` | warn | REQ-032 | the @silverpoint/fonts face failed to load; rendering fell back to the system stack | Install @silverpoint/fonts and import its stylesheet; golden images will not match until then |
| `SP014` | warn | REQ-204 | a dashboard cell spans more columns than the breakpoint has; it is clamped | Lower the span, or give that breakpoint more columns |
| `SP015` | warn | REQ-205 | the dashboard layout and its children disagree; unmatched children are placed in source order, span 1 | Give every child a `cell` the layout declares, once |
| `SP016` | warn | REQ-217 | a chart in a linked dashboard has no field named by `link.key`; it shows no linked mark | Link on a field every linked chart carries, or leave this chart out of the link |
| `SP017` | warn | REQ-324 | a value or a range cannot be drawn as given; it is clamped, rounded to its step or defaulted | Keep the value within `min`..`max` and on `step`, with `min < max` and `step > 0` |
| `SP018` | warn | REQ-319 | the component has no accessible name: no text content and no `label` | Give it visible text, or a `label` for an icon-only control |
| `SP019` | warn | REQ-325 | items share a key, or have none; the first is kept and the later ones are skipped | Give every item a unique, non-empty `key` |
| `SP020` | warn | REQ-437 | the hierarchy is invalid (a duplicate or empty `id`, a missing `parent`, a cycle, or several roots); the offending rows are dropped | Give every row a unique `id` and an existing `parent`, under a single root |
| `SP021` | warn | REQ-433 | a statistic parameter is invalid; its default is used | Keep the parameter in its documented range |
| `SP022` | warn | REQ-434 | a group has too few observations for its statistic; they are drawn as points | Give the group more observations, or expect it drawn as points |
| `SP023` | warn | REQ-466 | a palette colour is below its contrast threshold against its substrate; it is drawn as given | Recompute the palette with checkPalette(); colours are not chosen by eye |
| `SP024` | warn | REQ-467 | a palette field is unknown, or its value is not a CSS colour; the field is dropped | Use the fields of PALETTE_PROPERTIES with plain CSS colour values |
| `SP025` | warn | REQ-515 | @knight-lab/timelinejs could not be loaded; the fallback is rendered | Install the optional peer @knight-lab/timelinejs and import its stylesheet |

## Choosing a chart

| Data shape | Intent | Charts, best first |
|---|---|---|
| `series` | trend | `line-chart`: A line is the plainest reading of a value over an ordered axis.; `area-chart`: An area gives one series the weight of its magnitude.; `step-chart`: Steps show a value that holds until it changes.; `stream-chart`: Several value columns overlay or stack as waves.; `polar-line-chart`: A cyclic axis (hours, months, degrees) closes the line around a circle. |
| `series` | change | `line-chart`: The slope between points is the change.; `step-chart`: Steps mark when the value changed and by how much.; `area-chart`: An area shows the change in magnitude.; `bump-chart`: When the change that matters is in rank. |
| `series` | compare | `line-chart`: A second series draws as a dotted baseline against the first.; `composed-chart`: Columns and a line share one value scale.; `stream-chart`: Several series overlaid on one axis.; `sparkline-rows`: One small line per series, side by side with its readout.; `polar-line-chart`: Values around a cycle compared by angle. |
| `series` | rank | `bump-chart`: The rank of each series at each x, ranks joined across x. |
| `series` | kpi | `sparkline-rows`: One row per series: its name, its trend and its latest readout.; `kpi-card`: One metric, its delta and its trend. |
| `series` | part-to-whole | `stream-chart`: Stacked waves show each part of a total over x. |
| `categories` | compare | `bar-chart`: Bars compare values against one common baseline.; `lollipop-chart`: A lighter mark per category, readable with many of them.; `radar-chart`: Spokes compare a few subjects at once.; `polar-bar-chart`: Bars around a circle, for a cyclic set of categories.; `coxcomb-chart`: Equal angles, area by value: cyclic categories such as months.; `radial-arc-group`: Concentric tracks, each swept by its value. |
| `categories` | rank | `bar-chart`: Sorted bars read as a ranking.; `lollipop-chart`: Lollipops sort themselves with `sort`.; `pyramid-chart`: Stacked tiers, widest at the base.; `polar-bar-chart`: A ranking around a circle. |
| `categories` | part-to-whole | `stacked-bar-chart`: Each bar stacks its parts, one segment per value column.; `waterfall-chart`: Parts that add up to a running total.; `coxcomb-chart`: Sectors whose area is each part. |
| `categories` | change | `dumbbell-chart`: Two values per category joined by a segment: before and after.; `slope-chart`: Two period axes, one segment per category: the slope is the change.; `waterfall-chart`: Each step a delta from the running total. |
| `categories` | progress | `bullet-chart`: Each bar against its own target.; `radial-rings`: Concentric rings, each swept to its percent.; `funnel-chart`: Stages that narrow, such as a conversion.; `radial-arc-group`: Tracks swept relative to the largest. |
| `categories` | kpi | `bullet-chart`: Each measure against its target, compact.; `radial-rings`: A few percents at a glance. |
| `parts` | part-to-whole | `donut-chart`: A ring reads a few shares of one whole around a central figure.; `waffle-chart`: Unit cells make the shares countable.; `treemap-chart`: Tiles sized by share.; `diverging-bar-chart`: For ordered levels (agree… disagree) around a neutral centre.; `stacked-bar-chart`: One bar stacked with the shares, to set beside other wholes. |
| `parts` | compare | `diverging-bar-chart`: Likert-style levels on both sides of a neutral centre, row by row.; `waffle-chart`: Countable cells per part. |
| `parts` | progress | `waffle-chart`: A hundred cells filled to the share done. |
| `matrix` | compare | `heatmap-chart`: One toned cell per row and column.; `marimekko-chart`: Columns by total, segments by share.; `parallel-coordinates-chart`: One polyline per row across many dimensions. |
| `matrix` | part-to-whole | `marimekko-chart`: Each column a whole, each segment its share, column width by total. |
| `matrix` | correlation | `parallel-coordinates-chart`: Crossing lines between axes show how dimensions move together.; `heatmap-chart`: A grid of values, read for patterns. |
| `matrix` | distribution | `heatmap-chart`: Where the high values gather in the grid. |
| `hierarchy` | hierarchy | `tree-chart`: The structure itself, node by node.; `squarified-treemap`: Nested rectangles, drillable.; `sunburst-chart`: Rings of arcs, one ring per level, drillable. |
| `hierarchy` | part-to-whole | `squarified-treemap`: Area by value, nested by level.; `sunburst-chart`: Each arc its share of its parent. |
| `links` | flow | `sankey-chart`: Bands between layered stages, width by value.; `chord-ring`: Flows between categories around a circle, both ways.; `network-chart`: When the links matter more than their volume. |
| `links` | network | `network-chart`: Nodes and links laid out by a seeded force.; `chord-ring`: Who connects to whom, around a circle. |
| `links` | part-to-whole | `sankey-chart`: How a total splits and merges across stages. |
| `points` | correlation | `scatter-chart`: Points on two linear scales.; `bubble-chart`: A third variable as each point’s area.; `density-bin-chart`: Counts per bin when points overlap.; `connected-scatter-chart`: When the points have an order.; `polar-scatter-chart`: When one variable is an angle. |
| `points` | distribution | `density-bin-chart`: Points counted in hexagonal or square bins.; `contour-chart`: Iso-lines of the density.; `scatter-chart`: Every point, when there are few.; `polar-scatter-chart`: Points by angle and radius. |
| `points` | change | `connected-scatter-chart`: An ordered path through x-y points: how two values moved together. |
| `points` | network | `delaunay-chart`: Neighbours by triangulation, or each point’s Voronoi cell. |
| `points` | compare | `bubble-chart`: Positions and sizes compared at once. |
| `distribution` | distribution | `histogram-chart`: Observations binned in the core.; `box-plot-chart`: Quartiles, median, whiskers and outliers.; `violin-chart`: The density’s shape, mirrored.; `beeswarm-chart`: Every observation, packed without overlap.; `ecdf-chart`: The cumulative share below each value.; `wind-rose`: When the observations carry a bearing. |
| `distribution` | compare | `box-plot-chart`: Quartiles side by side, one box per group.; `violin-chart`: Density shapes side by side.; `ridgeline-chart`: Densities on overlapping baselines, one per group.; `ecdf-chart`: Cumulative curves of each group on one axis. |
| `distribution` | change | `ridgeline-chart`: A density per period, stacked in order. |
| `intervals` | uncertainty | `error-bar-chart`: A point estimate with its interval per category.; `range-band-chart`: A band between low and high over x. |
| `intervals` | trend | `range-band-chart`: The band between low and high over time.; `candlestick-chart`: Open, high, low and close per period. |
| `intervals` | change | `candlestick-chart`: Each period’s open-to-close change and its range. |
| `intervals` | schedule | `interval-chart`: Floating bars from start to end on lanes. |
| `events` | schedule | `activity-grid`: One cell per day, a column per week. |
| `events` | trend | `activity-grid`: Activity per day over weeks. |
| `single` | kpi | `kpi-card`: The figure, its delta and its trend.; `gauge-arc`: A percent on a 240° arc.; `meter-chart`: A percent with a needle. |
| `single` | progress | `gauge-arc`: An arc swept to the percent done.; `meter-chart`: A needle at the percent done. |
| `field` | flow | `vector-field-chart`: An arrow per grid point, its direction and magnitude. |
| `field` | distribution | `contour-chart`: Iso-lines and bands of a scalar grid (`source: 'grid'`). |
